Sam Hui Charity Concert Portrait

Sam Hui appears in a vibrant orange suit and a stack of colorful hats, smiling broadly as he holds a harmonica. His expressive eyes and relaxed posture convey the approachable charm that has defined his decades-long career in Cantonese pop music.
